Progen Royal Ruby Emerus — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands

A ruby supercar worth a small house sleeps in a mansion garage on the same island as the green coupe.

Full guide — contains spoilers

This standout Progen Emerus is garaged at the Vespucci Mansion on Neptune Circle, Vespucci Island; another report describes it as a crime boss's house in the Rialto Islands. It is a serious prize: one source reports a sale value of $33,000, with acceleration and handling both rated 8.4, and treats it as a Key Cloner-era target rather than a Chapter 2 grab. A second, incompatible account (single-source aggregators GTA6 Pocket and Kuhung) claims the car is tracker-free with a $29,900 registration saving — a Chapter 2 free-registration candidate. The two accounts cannot both be right; both are recorded here.

Source & evidence

Source: GTA 6 unique cars: best ones, where they are, how to keep — LeonidaHub (2026-11-22).

Evidence: Aggregated guide citing egamersworld and VicePulse for the garage, gameta for stats. Two incompatible single-source accounts: $33,000 sale / Key Cloner-era target (egamersworld via LeonidaHub) vs tracker-free / $29,900 registration (GTA6 Pocket, Kuhung). Kept at creator-reported until a hands-on guide settles it.
